description: Attaches (or removes, with domain: null) a custom domain to a site. Setting a domain automatically onboards a Cloudflare zone for its root domain — the owner still has to point their registrar's nameservers at the ones returned by get_zone.

domain.description: The custom domain to attach (e.g. 'shop.example.com'), or null to remove the current one.

site_id.description: The site's id, from list_sites or create_site.

name: set_domain
title: Set custom domain
